name: Mantled Hawk
rangeDescription: Tropical forest of eastern brazil to eastern uruguay and eastern paraguay
description: Largish hawk with a short tail and very broad wings. White head, belly and tail with a barred black back.

name: Seram Myzomela
rangeDescription: Southern moluccas (seram, ambon, and boano)
description: A small, drab brown songbird with an entirely blackish downcurved bill and subtle scaling on the throat. Restricted to Seram, Boano, and Ambon islands.

name: Scarlet-banded Barbet
rangeDescription: Northern peru: very local on ridge crests of cordillera azul (eastern san martín and southwestern loreto)
description: Spectacular cloud forest bird found only in remote mountains east of the main cordillera of the Andes in northern Peru. Distinctive in its small range with red crown and breast band, white throat, and yellow flanks.

name: Band-tailed Cacique
rangeDescription: Tropical southeastern colombia to northeastern peru and far western brazil
description: A large cacique, more reminiscent of an oropendola than most other cacique species. Highly local in western Amazonia, where it is mostly associated with flooded forests.

name: Arabian Lark
rangeDescription: Southwestern arabia
description: A chunky, large-billed lark of desolate sandy deserts and open arid plains of the Arabian Peninsula. Plain sandy-brown above and paler below, with faint white markings and a dark moustache mark on the face.

name: Ochre-browed Thistletail
rangeDescription: Andes of western venezuela (northern táchira, mérida, and trujillo)
description: Tiny bird with a long, spiky red tail, a vocal and active resident of grass and bushes above treeline. Dull brown upperparts, grayish brown underparts, and a distinctive orange face and chin.

name: Balsas Screech-Owl
rangeDescription: Southwestern mexico (southern jalisco and colima to western guerrero)
description: Medium-sized owl (but large for a screech-owl) with short ear tufts and brownish (not yellow) eyes. Fairly common in scrubby woodland, thorn forest, and edge of interior southwest Mexico where it is endemic.

name: Spoon-billed Sandpiper
rangeDescription: Breeds northeastern siberia; winters in southeastern asia
description: Critically endangered, highly distinctive stint with spatulate bill tip that can be difficult to spot at a distance when held in profile. A coastal mudflat specialist, it stays close to wet and muddy areas near or in water, unlike Red-necked Stint, which often feeds in much drier areas.

name: Royal Penguin
rangeDescription: Macquarie island and adjacent islets
description: The largest crested penguin, with a diagnostic whitish face. Only breeds on the Australian-administered Macquarie Island; occasionally seen off of New Zealand’s subantarctic islands, rarely off of the mainland.

name: Madagascar Snipe
rangeDescription: Marshes of eastern and central massif of madagascar
description: Chunky, cryptic, short-legged, long-billed shorebird. Found in thickly vegetated wetlands, including rice fields, in eastern and central Madagascar.

name: Rota White-eye
rangeDescription: Sabena plateau on rota (southernmost northern mariana islands)
description: A small bird, olive-green above and yellow below, with a bold white eye-ring and a yellow bill. Yellow in front of eye and on throat gives a yellow-faced appearance.

name: Kipengere Seedeater
rangeDescription: Southern tanzania (mount rungwe and udzungwa mountains)
description: A large seedeater with a big, bulging bill. Dark brown above and white below with heavily streaked underparts.

name: Chuuk Monarch
rangeDescription: Chuuk (eastern caroline islands)
description: Medium-sized flycatcher-like bird with a long pointed bill. Male is bright white with a black face and throat.

name: Grande Comore Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Grand comoro island (mount karthala)
description: A distinctive and attractive flycatcher that is endemic to Grand Comoro. Dark brown on the upperparts and heavily streaked below, with a yellow bill and feet and white wingbars.

name: Variable Chachalaca
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela, the guianas, and northern amazonian brazil
description: Slender, long-tailed, chickenlike bird that is often seen in small groups. Grayish-brown overall with a warmer chestnut head.

name: Ibadan Malimbe
rangeDescription: Savanna of southwestern nigeria
description: A striking black-and-red forest malimbe. Male has a black face and a red crown, nape, neck, and breast; female similar, with a narrower breast band.

name: Cocos Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Cocos island (off western costa rica)
description: Attractive cuckoo endemic to Cocos Island, located in the Pacific Ocean about 300 miles southwest of mainland Costa Rica. It has tawny underparts, brown upperparts, chestnut wings, black mask, and yellow on the bottom of its bill.

name: Common Scoter
rangeDescription: Breeds southeastern greenland, iceland, scotland, and northern and western scandinavia to olenyok river (north-central siberia); winters to baltic and north sea coasts, and eastern atlantic coast to northwestern africa
description: Fairly common sea duck; feeds by diving. Breeds on tundra lakes; winters at sea in coastal bays, estuaries, harbors.

name: Principe Thrush
rangeDescription: Príncipe island (gulf of guinea)
description: A large brown thrush with pale blue-gray eyes, a bright yellow bill, and scaly underparts. The juvenile is flecked with buffy above.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Aldabra White-eye
rangeDescription: Aldabra and astove islands (indian ocean)
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Note the yellow patches on the throat and undertail and the white spectacles around the eye.
